title: Cloud-Native AI Agents: Scaling Intelligent Workflows with LangChain
summary: Akshay Mittal explains how cloud-native practices help LangChain agents scale in production.

chapters.title: Why AI Agents and Cloud Native
Collier King on His Vectorize Package

learn: LLMs are resource intensive and have unpredictable scaling needs, so traditional scaling is not enough.
Agents act as autonomous decision makers, chains handle sequential steps, and memory manages context, which maps well to microservices.
Deployment tips: containerize with Kubernetes, use serverless such as AWS Lambda, store embedded context in vector databases and monitor latency with Prometheus.
A financial services case uses 25 specialized agents for retrieval, with a sidecar pattern, an event mesh and model routing.
Challenges he names: data privacy, model drift and real-time inference cost. His advice: start small, maybe with a chatbot, then scale.
